Transfers from the Total column: Transfer from other funds 98,800 (from the Sanitation Fund) and Transfer to Genoa Medical Facility 50,395. Business-type from the proprietary statement p7 (net position); receipts = operating revenues 377,490 + interest 816. Proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule, so no detail for them. Department functions follow the statement: Cemetery is in Public works (p5 public works 12,901), TIF payments in Economic development; p5 general government 207,017 vs departments 207,019, environment and leisure 234,140 vs 234,139 (rounding).
